data.gender_notes: Sivaranjani is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sivaranjani is derived from the Tamil language and is a combination of two words - Siva (God) and Ranjanam (one who pleases or delights). The name signifies the Goddess who delights and pleases the God Shiva. It is a name that evokes feelings of love, gratitude, and victory. The name Sivaranjani carries the meaning “Goddess of Gratitude and Love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sivaranjani usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of gratitude and love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sivaranjani is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality and represents the Goddess Parvati, who is the consort of Lord Shiva. The name is believed to bestow blessings of love, happiness, and prosperity. It is a powerful name that resonates with the divine energies of the universe and is often chanted during religious ceremonies and rituals.
data.etymology: Sivaranjani belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Gratitude and Love.”

data.cultural_impact: The name Sivaranjani holds immense significance in Hindu culture, particularly in the southern parts of India such as Tamil Nadu and Kerala. Goddess Sivaranjani is often depicted as the consort and divine companion of Lord Shiva. She is known to be the one who calms and soothes Lord Shiva, and her blessings are believed to bring happiness, harmony, prosperity, and success to those who worship her. The name also finds mention in various Hindu scriptures and literary works, underscoring its importance in the Hindu tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, the name Sivaranjani signifies the inner divine feminine aspect within each of us. It reminds us of the ability to bring joy, peace, and fulfillment to ourselves and those around us. The name invokes the qualities of compassion, grace, love, and surrender, and encourages us to connect with our higher selves and the divine presence within us. It serves as a reminder of the power of gratitude, love, and devotion to bring about inner peace and outer success.
